text.p: Batteries Batteries Inc on Wednesday it completed a cash and stock transaction to acquire Battery Network Inc and its affiliated companies.

Batteries Batteries said in a release that the purchase involved payment of $8.4 million cash, 550,000 shares of the common stock of the company and a five-year option to purchase an additional 225,000 shares.
Batteries Batterties stock was 1/8 higher at 4-1/4 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
The company said the acquisition was funded under a $13 million secured revolving credit and term-loan facility with a group of lenders headed by IBJ Schroder Bank & Trust Co.
As part of the deal, the company acquired Alexander Battery Co East Inc, Alexander Battery Co South Inc, and Alexander Battery Co West Inc.

Battery Network Inc is an assembler and wholesale distributor of batteries, servicing customers throughout the United States. Its principal operations are located in California, Illinois and New Jersey.
